text: Shipped 0.1 after ~30s of holding W; clear toast 'Shipped 0.1. New module: search.' Intro message taught pushing well.

Open-issues row overflows the 640px window: 'auth   expiring certificate84%   -60%/min  fa' - the name runs into the percent with no space and the last column is clipped at the right edge. Also the help bar vanished at the same time the stamina bar appeared.

Patching auth: the 'Patching [#############]' bar looked full after 2 s of holding E but the module (67%) was not yet fixed; it took another ~3 s hold. The bar does not seem to show real progress, or resets when E is released.

HUD says 'OPEN ISSUES 2' but lists no issue rows, only '... and 2 more lines' - the player cannot see which modules are failing. (Taken while pushing on the slope between 0.3 and 0.4, with the slope hint and billing prompt also on screen.)

At 0.5 a 'Rain: the path is slick' line is added to the HUD and now even the 'OPEN ISSUES 3' heading is gone: the panel shows only '... and 3 more lines'. The issue list appears to have a fixed line budget that the HUD rows above consume.

OUTAGE: users are leaving (400->338) while the issues panel shows only '... and 5 more lines': I cannot tell which module is down or where on the boulder it is. The only hint was a floating 'billing' label seen earlier. The game asks me to patch, retire or refactor, but hides the list of what.

Sitting (Q) on the slope: the boulder rolled back down to the 0.6 terrace (lost ~22 m of climb), but this sitting view is the FIRST place the game names the failing module: 'OUTAGE: router is down'. Nice line 'The boulder is still. For a moment, so are you.'

Spent ~3 min walking around the boulder on the 0.6 terrace looking for 'router' (down): no prompt names it, no issue row, and the red glow seen from below sits on the top, out of the ~3 m reach. Users fell 400 -> 146 meanwhile. Gave up at the time limit.
